Ikemoto, '2nd qualification test series results of the upper stage engine LE-5B-3 for H3 rocket', 8th European Conference for Aeronautics and Space Sciences (EUCASS), 2019, DOI 10.13009/EUCASS2019-626, s.3 Tablo 1 (LE-5B-3 sutunu)
source.extraction_note: Sayilar EUCASS2019-626 PDF Tablo 1 LE-5B-3 sutunundan dogrudan okundu (https://www.eucass.eu/doi/EUCASS2019-0626.pdf): vakum itki 137.2 kN, vakum Isp 448.0 s, MR 5.0, oda basinci 3.61 MPa, genisleme orani 110, cevrim 'Expander bleed', firing duration 740 s, kutle 303 kg, boy 2.79 m. Yazarlar JAXA + MHI. [access orijinal etiketi: 'conference_paper']

units_original: kN, s, MPa, kg, m, - (EUCASS2019-626 Tablo 1 orijinal birimleri)
notes: H3 2. kademe motoru (JAXA/MHI). Ust kademe: dusuk Pc (3.61 MPa) + yuksek genisleme 110 -> yuksek vakum Isp (448.0 s). Cevrim 'expander bleed', HRMA 'expander' ile esitlendi (bleed dumpi kucuk pozitif Isp sapmasi dogurabilir). LE-5B-2 (liq-le5b2-h2a-spec) ile birlikte Isp-iyilestirme cifti: LE-5B-2 446.8 s -> LE-5B-3 448.0 s (+1.2 s, ayni Pc/MR/genisleme bandinda mikser iyilestirmesi). Firing duration 740 s performans olcusu degil, gorev suresi — measured'a yazilmadi.
